mentions.name: LLM-Resistant CAPTCHA
mentions.description: A new CAPTCHA designed to be very simple and user-friendly for humans while maintaining strong protection against LLM-powered bots. It is currently seeking pilot users to test it out and provide feedback.
mentions.audience: Content creators, site owners, and anyone interested, recruited as pilot users to test it and provide feedback
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a new CAPTCHA designed to be very simple and user-friendly for humans, while maintaining strong LLM bot protection. I'm currently looking for pilot users (content creators, site owners, or anyone interested) to test it out and provide feedback.
